training_template.loss_masking: prompt part masked with -100, loss on target tokens only
training_template.collator: TargetOnlyDataCollator preserves precomputed labels; input padding uses pad_token_id; attention padding uses 0; label padding uses -100
training_template.truncation: tokenize prompt and target separately; reserve the complete FINAL_LABEL=X + EOS target; truncate prompt only; fail if target cannot fit

formal_inference_protocol.batching: per-sample model.generate, same as the frozen Base eval
formal_inference_protocol.latency: time.perf_counter around generate with torch.cuda.synchronize before/after; model/tokenizer/CSV loading excluded
formal_inference_protocol.invalid_handling: prediction=-1 counted as wrong, kept in the 500-row denominator

decision_basis.train_size: baseline doc recommends 10,000-20,000 rows; smoke throughput after target-only loss-mask fix: 2.81 examples/s -> 20,000 x 3 epochs ~ 5.9 h; 50,588 x 3 epochs ~ 14.6 h exceeds the 3-day budget
decision_basis.inference_mode: BF16 base + LoRA adapter verified compatible in the 4A smoke (loaded, bf16, cuda:0, stable generation, parser ok); the frozen Base formal result used BF16 with no quantization, so BF16_BASE_PLUS_ADAPTER keeps the comparison single-variable (adapter on/off)
decision_basis.max_seq_length: frozen 20k train token lengths: p50=282, p90=345, p99=446, max=10308; 1024 truncates only 69/20000 (0.3%) and matches the inference max_input_length
